name: TVS Motor Company Ltd
title: TVS Motor Company Ltd - 532343 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: TVS Motor posted record FY26 (volume 5.9m, +24%; EBITDA margin 12.9%) and is adding 1.5m units of capacity to ~8.3m, but Q1 faces 3-5% commodity inflation and supply-chain disruption that channel stock is absorbing.

utilisation.quote: we don't keep more than 30 days of stock with our dealers in India

capex.quote: the capex for next year for TVS Motor will be likely to be around INR3,500 crores

triggers.label: Capacity +1.5m units to ~8.3m
triggers.quote: we are looking at increasing the capacity by another 1.5 million, to go to somewhere around 8.3 million

triggers.label: Channel stock below normal in Q4
triggers.quote: Channel stock has started improving this month because we were able to produce much better in the first 10 days of May

triggers.label: Commodity inflation 3-5%, 35% offset
triggers.quote: I think it is around 3% to 5% because as we speak, there are challenges, but we were able to increase prices 35% of the price increases

triggers.label: FY27 industry growth strong single digit
triggers.quote: we are expecting a good single-digit growth on the industry this year

guidance.quote: we are expecting a good single-digit growth on the industry this year
the capex for next year for TVS Motor will be likely to be around INR3,500 crores
it will be 70% of the current year, somewhere around that
We have now moved maybe around 40,000 and we will soon move to 50,000 per month

red_flags.label: Q1 supply disruption and channel stock below normal
red_flags.quote: we had some challenges in the supply chain, with respect to labor availability, gas and also some challenges in terms of on-time availability of some raw material

red_flags.label: Management declines margin guidance
red_flags.quote: Normally, I don't give you any guidance on margin, okay?

evasions.quote: Normally, I don't give you any guidance on margin, okay? Because we don't look at -- pricing is a strategy.

evasions.topic: New investments outside Norton, Dubai, TVS Credit
evasions.quote: closer to the investment, we will let you know
